page.notes: The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The italic passage is Genesis 3:16–19 as printed; the printed word "Ada" is read as shown, and the swash initials of "Ada" and "Quia" are read as plain letters. "1000" is printed in old-style figures that look like "1ooo"; read as 1000 with [?]. The last line ends at "manum, v" and the rest of the word, "xorem", stands as catchword at the foot. "fuscipiunt" and "face-re" carry the printed line-end breaks; the break in "fuscipiunt" has no visible hyphen, so it is written whole. Page number and running head are printed at the top: "16" left, "CONCIONES" right.
